summary: First iteration E2E testing of Agentic Builder. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed covering health, models (scan + list of 7 seeded), phases (4 with phase1 active), tasks CRUD, run start/list/get, events streaming, latest summary, ZIP download (validated structure + agentic-builder-phase1/ prefix + >=10 files). The real Claude Sonnet 4.5 loop was driven end-to-end and a 2-iteration run completed in ~15s. Frontend: all 7 routes load without errors, Dashboard metrics + live widgets (run meta, iteration timeline with PLAN/CODE/TEST/PERCEIVE/DIAGNOSE/FIX/DONE pills, dark live code viewer, perception panel with synthesized vision counts, diagnosis OK pill) render correctly after a run; Models page shows 7 cards with capability badges (code/chat/vision) and auto-selected highlight on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct; TaskBuilder form + JSON preview + example buttons + Start run navigates to /runs/:id and toast 'Run started' appears; Runs page shows completed runs with COMPLETED status, iter 2/2, durations; Phases page shows ACTIVE label for phase1; Download page shows download button pointing to /api/download/phase1.zip. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated; migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, cosmetic).

agent_runner._llm swallows LLM errors as a string '[LLM unavailable: ...]' — if the key is ever missing the code block extraction would silently produce a non-code run with no user-facing warning. Consider surfacing an error event so the UI can show a clear failure state.
run_agent_loop emits FIX stage as info only; the final iteration's 'fix' event is emitted even after the loop exits without using the new code. Minor UX polish.
Dashboard polls latestSummary every 1.2s unconditionally from every user — fine for demo but consider stop-on-complete to reduce load.
TaskBuilder does not validate max_iterations range on the client before POST; backend also has no explicit max constraint (user could submit 100+).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test runs (TEST_run_adhoc, smoke test) and 1 test task (TEST_task_1) via pytest and UI. All persisted cleanly in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file is at /app/backend/tests/test_agentic_builder.py — reuse for regression. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set. Agent loop takes ~10-15s for 2 iterations; bump the test_run_completes_eventually timeout if running with max_iterations>4. Vision events, test pass/fail, HF registry are MOCKED per spec — do not test for deterministic outcomes.
